description: Charge-air, exhaust, wastegate and fuel parameters used by the turbo matching model. All values are modeled engineering estimates for the game catalogue parts, not measured data.

chargeAir._note: Pressure loss dp = lossBarAtRef * (flow / refFlowLbMin)^2 for the intercooler + piping, and filterLossBarAtRef likewise for the inlet. Effectiveness drops once flow exceeds the core's reference flow.

exhaust._note: Post-turbine back pressure dp = 2757 * restriction * flow^2 / pipeMm^4 (bar, flow in lb/min); calibrated to about 0.25 bar for a 76 mm straight-through system at 55 lb/min.

wastegate._note: flowLbMin = wastegate flow capacity (corrected lb/min, fully open, choked expansion ratio) of the valve itself: a wastegate is an orifice, independent of the turbine it sits next to. Internal flap ports are ~22-26 mm, a 44 mm external valve has ~3x that area. shaftSpeedSensor lets the controller cap boost at the shaft limit.

rotorInertia._note: Modeled: I = refKgM2 * (turbineMm / refTurbineMm)^exponent. Ball-bearing G-series cores use the same rule.
